verdict.rationale: Raygun docs reference a public API (Deployments API, JS source-map upload API, external access tokens for various services) implying programmatic access exists, and a third-party MCP server exists for tool integration. However, no dedicated API reference or OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found (probes for openapi.json/llms.txt returned 404s), so the API's documentation depth for AI-native automation is unclear. Missing for 10: a full public API reference/spec, first-party API docs page, and confirmation of comprehensive endpoint coverage beyond token-based uploads.
